overview.description: The Tradr 2X Short LITE Daily ETF (LITZ) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund provides inverse (-2x) exposure, less fees and expenses, to the daily price movement for shares of Lumentum Holdings stock. LITZ was launched on Apr 22, 2026 and is issued by Tradr.
